findings.problem: Subject uses banned pressure phrase 'LAST CHANCE', 'guaranteed to pass your test' and '!!!'. It implies a guaranteed passing result. The subject is also 51 characters, over the 50 limit.
findings.fix: Use a calm subject of 50 characters or fewer, such as 'Book on-site testing at your workplace'. Drop the guarantee and pressure wording.

findings.problem: Preview states an unconfirmed price ($49), turnaround ('Results in 1 hour') and service area ('anywhere in the city'). It also says the test will 'help you pass'. The preview is about 82 characters, so length is fine.
findings.fix: Remove the price, turnaround, service area and pass language. Use something like 'A technician comes to you. Private and confidential.'

findings.problem: The greeting is 'Hi,' and does not use {{first_name}}.

The body says 'last chance' and 'guaranteed to pass your test'. It states $49 and 'results in 1 hour' as facts. It also mentions 'your results'. That breaks the rules on guarantees, unconfirmed prices and turnaround times, results, and pressure language.
findings.fix: Rewrite in calm, plain English. Say a technician comes on site and keeps it private. Remove the guarantee, price, turnaround and pressure wording.

findings.problem: 'We know about your court order' states why the reader needs a test and implies knowledge of their case. 'Book today before it is too late' is a pressure phrase.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence. Offer a calm invitation to book a test or a call, such as 'You can book a test when it suits you.'

findings.problem: The email has two links. The second one, 'our other page' at /offers, breaks the one-main-link rule. The first link also lacks an on-brand button text like 'Book a test'.
findings.fix: Remove the /offers link (line 12). Keep one link, such as [Book a test](https://roadsideresults.example/book?src=e1).

findings.problem: The sign-off is 'Thanks, The team', not the required 'Roadside Results Mobile Testing'. The required two-line plain-text footer is missing. It needs the consent line, {{company_address}} and {{unsubscribe_url}}.
findings.fix: End with the sign-off 'Roadside Results Mobile Testing', then the two footer lines exactly as written in .claude/rules/emails.md.
